subject: Safeguard Health - post-call: hosting path, audit evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@safeguardhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Safeguard - call recap & asks (hosting, SOC2, BAA)

Hi Laura — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on hosting path and evidence for your compliance review.

Call summary (short):
- Primary constraint: Safeguard will process PHI; must be HIPAA-covered with BAA and demonstrable controls. SOC 2 Type II preferred for vendor security evidence.
- Deployment options under consideration: Redwood Hosted API (fastest), Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), Redwood Private VPC / on-prem (for strict network isolation).
- Your security team flagged audit windows and the need for network diagrams + log retention details for the vendor risk questionnaire.

Immediate asks (what we need from you):
1) Confirm whether Private VPC or on-prem is a hard requirement for pilot, or if Dedicated with VPC peering would suffice for the initial PoC.
2) Share any target audit dates or vendor review timelines (so we prioritize evidence delivery).

What we'll provide by end of week:
- Redacted SOC2 Type II summary + description of scoping (attached stub: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf).
- BAA template (we can start countersigning once scope is agreed).
- High-level network diagram and controls checklist for the chosen hosting path.

Proposed next steps:
- You share target audit/review date and whether Private VPC is required for the pilot.
- If useful, schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) where our solutions engineer (Aditya) can walk your infra/security team through architecture and logging.

If you prefer, we can also prepare a short comparison table that maps required evidence to each hosting option (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — I can drop that in the HubSpot record.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
email: evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com | mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@safeguardhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Mark Davis <mark.d@safeguardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safeguard - call recap & asks (hosting, SOC2, BAA)

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Compliance constraints: HIPAA/BAA is mandatory. We require a signed BAA before any production PHI is processed. For the pilot, our security team is open to Dedicated capacity with strict VPC peering and customer-controlled keys, but they will escalate Private/on-prem if they find gaps in the audit evidence.

2) Evidence: Please provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 summary) and the BAA template. Also need answers on: encryption at rest (KMS), encryption in transit, separation of PHI logs, and retention period for audit logs.

3) Timeline: We have a vendor review meeting on Aug 26 — if possible, can you get the SOC2 summary + BAA draft to us by Aug 20? That will give our security folks time to review ahead of the meeting.

4) Cost sensitivity: We will evaluate cost tradeoffs between Dedicated and Private. Can you include a ballpark delta (monthly) between Dedicated and Private for a mid-size pilot (approx 4–8 GPU equivalent)?

Attaching our vendor questionnaire for reference (Safeguard_security_q4_2026.xlsx).

Laura Chen
Head of IT Security
Safeguard Health, Inc.
laura.chen@safeguardhealth.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@safeguardhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Safeguard - call recap & asks (hosting, SOC2, BAA)

Laura — great, appreciate the timeline. Below are the direct answers and a proposed delivery plan.

Direct answers (short):
- SOC2: We will provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report and a one-page controls mapping by Aug 20.
- BAA: We'll send our BAA template today (attached) — happy to iterate with legal.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest via customer-managed KMS (for Dedicated/Private) or Redwood-managed KMS for Hosted; TLS 1.2+/mTLS options for in-transit.
- Logs/retention: Audit logs retained for 90 days by default; can extend to customer-specified retention ranges via Dedicated/Private. PHI-related access logs are segmented and can be exported to your SIEM via secure forwarding.

Estimated cost delta (ballpark monthly for 4–8 GPU-equivalent pilot):
- Redwood Dedicated: ~$18k–$30k/month (depends on instance mix, autoscaling headroom).
- Redwood Private (VPC / managed private control plane): ~$35k–$60k/month (includes private networking, higher support & compliance package).
- Hosted API: cheapest to start (metered), but will require an approved BAA + scoping conversation; not ideal for long-term high-traffic PHI workloads.

Proposed delivery plan:
- Today: send BAA template (attached: BAA_template_redwood.docx).
- By Aug 20: SOC2 summary + controls mapping (attached: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf).
- By Aug 21: Network diagram and sample logging export config for Dedicated and Private options.
- Aug 24–25: Tech deep-dive with Aditya (solutions architect) + your infra folks (30–45m).

Action items for Safeguard:
- Confirm whether Dedicated with VPC peering is acceptable for pilot, or whether Private is required up-front.
- Confirm any non-negotiable audit evidence fields beyond SOC2 + BAA (e.g., external pen test report).

I'll add the SOC2 summary to the HubSpot deal and drop the DocuSign link for the BAA when you're ready.

—
Evelyn
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Safeguard - call recap & asks (hosting, SOC2, BAA)

Looping in engineering/solutions for costs and architecture. A few internal notes:
- Pricing: Please prepare a short pricing model showing Dedicated vs Private for the 4–8 GPU pilot (monthly committed vs burst). Include optional add-on for extended log retention (365 days).
- Evidence to share publicly: SOC2 summary and BAAs are fine to share; full SOC2 reports are redacted. No pen-test attachments without approvals.
- Aditya: can you run through a one-pager that maps the security questionnaire items (Laura attached) to our standard evidence artifacts and hosting options? Planning to propose Aug 24 at 10:00 PT for the deep-dive — Evelyn, can you confirm?

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@safeguardhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Mark Davis <mark.d@safeguardhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safeguard - call recap & asks (hosting, SOC2, BAA)

Thanks, Evelyn & Vivek — that plan works. Confirming:
- We'll review the SOC2 summary + BAA draft on Aug 20.
- Aug 24 at 10:00 PT is good for the technical deep-dive (Laura, Mark + two infra folks). Please send calendar invite and dial-in.
- For the pilot, Dedicated with VPC peering is acceptable provided the log forwarding and KMS options are in place; we will escalate to Private if we discover gaps in the evidence.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire (Safeguard_security_q4_2026.xlsx) to the thread for your mapping.

Laura Chen
